description_en: Queries whether a free one-click scan can be submitted. The scan scope includes free vulnerability scanning categories and free CSPM check items
description_zh: 获取能否提交免费一键检测，检测范围包含免费漏洞检测类别和CSPM免费检查项
name: GetTenantCheckAvailable

NextScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the next time when a one-click scan can be submitted
NextScanTime.description_zh: 下一次可以提交一键检测时间的时间戳

Status.description_en:
The current status of the one-click scan. Valid values:

0: The one-click scan can be submitted.

1: The current task is not complete. The scan cannot be submitted.

2: The free scan quota for this week has been used. Wait until the next free scan time
Status.description_zh:
当前一键检测状态，枚举值：

0：可以提交一键检测。

1：当前任务尚未完成，无法提交检测。

2：本周检测免费检测额度已使用，需等待下次免费检测时间

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
